newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ SPORT-RUGBY UNION-Sotutu, Kerr join Canty Crusaders.
newsitem.headline: NZ SPORT-RUGBY UNION-Sotutu, Kerr join Canty Crusaders.

text.p: CHRISTCHURCH, Dec 2 - Aucklanders Waisake Sotutu and James Kerr have been drafted into the Canterbury Crusaders rugby squad for next year's Super 12 series, NZPA reports.
Sotutu, the 1994 NPC player of the year, and Kerr will give the Crusaders speed and penetration out wide which they lacked this season.
Other members of the squad taken in the draft are Norman Maxwell (Northland), Mark Weedon (North Harbour) and John Akurangi (Auckland).
Marlborough first five-eighths Leon MacDonald is the only player in the region, not living in Christchurch, to make the 25-player squad.
Crusaders coach Wayne Smith said Sotutu had just undergone surgery to a troublesome knee and was keen to get to Christchurch to start training.
"He is looking to relaunch a career that took him within a whisker of All Black honours in 1994 and last year," Smith said.
Missing from this season's squad are Simon Forrest and Adrian Tukaki, both injured, and Richard Loe, not wanted by Smith.
The Crusaders had earlier announced the signing of Darryl Lilley (Taranaki) and Kevin Nepia (Auckland).
The Super 12 is now regarded as the toughest competition in world rugby and the Crusaders said they plan to make the top eight after finishing last this year.

Darryl Lilley, Paul Bale, Daryl Gibson, James Kerr, Tabai Matson, Waisake Sotutu, Mark Mayerhoffler, Andrew Mehrtens, Leon MacDonald, Justin Marshall, Aaron Flynn; Todd Blackadder (captain), Steve Surridge, Scott Robertson, Angus Gardiner, Clark McLeod, Norman Maxwell, Steve Lancaster, Mark Weedon, Con
Barrell, Kevin Nepia, Stu Loe, John Akurangi, Matt Sexton, Mark Hammett.
